description: This source file implements a routing strategy class (`LowestTPMLoggingHandler_v2`) that manages deployment selection based on TPM (Tokens Per Minute) and RPM (Requests Per Minute) metrics. It handles both synchronous and asynchronous operations for rate limiting, caching, and deployment selection, with detailed logging and error handling.
